wiki.title: Ray Jeffers
wiki.extract: Brannon Ray Jeffers an American politician who is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing the 2nd district (including all of Person County, as well as part of Durham County) since 2023. Jeffers previously served on the Person County Board of Commissioners from 2008 to 2020.
